identity.name: PINDER-S
identity.primary_subset: All 93 PINDER-S complexes with primary paired apo structures

found_basis: Public published PINDER source includes executable evaluation CLI and FroDock adapter; published docking script and accessible inputs are identified. Execution not tested.

outcome_definition.scientific_question: Does additional parallel search improve recovery of experimental protein interfaces within fixed time or compute?
outcome_definition.ranking: Report rank-1 and oracle best among fixed top 5 separately; top-5 reporting supported by published evaluator.
outcome_definition.limits: No inference of BBB transcytosis, affinity or therapeutic relevance; AAV separated-component redocking is not paired-unbound docking.

citations.title: PINDER: The Protein INteraction Dataset and Evaluation Resource
DockQ: A Quality Measure for Protein-Protein Docking Models
FRODOCK: a new approach for fast rotational protein-protein docking

source_licences.intended_use: local scientific docking evaluation; retain licence and attribution on redistribution

source_licences.item: PINDER index, metadata, mappings and distributed structural inputs
source_licences.reason: Repository Apache licence observed; explicit coverage of separately hosted data and derived metadata not established. PDB coordinate origins have CC0 coverage; that alone does not establish terms for all distributed annotations.

Official licence evidence could not be fetched (dead documentation routes); mirror README gives usage and citation instructions but no explicit licence for scoring bytes. Owner authorizes local use of unverified mirror; this does not establish third-party rights or study identity.

stock_cuda_image.reason: Stock CUDA image version, installed libraries and architecture unspecified; no build or workload run. Published baseline uses Linux amd64 CPU MPI, FFTW single precision and GCC; CUDA not required by FroDock. PINDER requires Python >=3.10 and fastpdb may need Rust on older glibc. Adapter and Dockerfile defects need reproduction and repair.

size.reason: Inventory is a superset including auxiliary files, compressed archives and code; not unique representative resident data. MPI grid memory, candidate output sizes and peak RSS/VRAM not measured.

scoring_rules.success_rate: Fraction of fixed eligible cases with at least one acceptable pose at rank 1 or among top 5; report separately. Missing/failed cases remain in denominator and are reported.
scoring_rules.reason: No matched aggregate published FroDock success or timing value established during bounded intake. No invented tolerance.

repeatability.case_selection: Fixed full 93-case paired-primary-apo subset of release 2024-02; no scale search.
repeatability.seed_reason: Brief requires independent random seeds but supplies no values, repeat count or published FroDock seed switch. Fix and record before stochastic experiments; do not claim deterministic MPI repeats are independent random seeds.
repeatability.mirror_caveat: unverified_mirror; published-value agreement cannot authenticate original software or scoring bytes.

gate_scripts_reason: No gate script names or paths supplied; JSON completeness and anchor schema checked locally.
